name: nest_home_control

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Bare uppercase one of: HEAT, COOL, OFF.

arguments_prompt:
Read or set the Nest thermostat. Pass nothing to read current state.

Fields (all optional):
  - `mode`               — `HEAT`, `COOL`, or `OFF`. Bare uppercase.
  - `target_temperature` — Fahrenheit number (e.g. 75).

Examples:
  Change setpoint:           `{ "target_temperature": 75 }`
  Switch to cooling at 72:   `{ "mode": "COOL", "target_temperature": 72 }`
  Read current state:        `{}`
